highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.1 disables RAW and DNG image decoding.
highlights_body: Use a dedicated RAW-image decoder before passing supported raster data to SkiaSharp.

breaking.title: RAW and DNG decoding disabled
breaking.body: The bundled codec no longer decodes RAW or DNG images. Decode these formats with a dedicated library and provide a supported raster image to SkiaSharp instead.

v4.153.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.1 disables RAW and DNG image decoding.
v4.153.1.body: Applications that process these formats should decode them before handing raster data to SkiaSharp.
